text:
A 30-minute year-end checklist for your business's online presence:

☐ Google Business Profile: hours for the holidays and January, 5 new photos
☐ Reviews: reply to every review from this year that you missed
☐ Website: prices, phone numbers and staff names still correct?
☐ WhatsApp Business: away message and quick replies still say the right things?
☐ Instagram bio: does it say what you do, where, and how to book?
☐ Customer list: export your contacts and past customers into one sheet
☐ Numbers: how many enquiries and customers did you get this year, and from where?

The last one is the most useful. It tells you where to spend your time next year.

Save this for the last week of December.
